rules.statement: In test code, when two or more test suites need the same helper functions or fixture constants, define them once in a shared helper file that each suite imports (dot-sources), instead of copying them into each suite.
rules.why: Copies drift apart: a later fix to one copy can miss the other, and the suites diverge without anyone noticing.
rules.check: Look for helper functions or constants (such as fixture builders or embedded base64 data) in a new or changed test file that are also defined, with the same or near-identical body, in another test file. If you find a copy, ask for it to move into a shared helper. The shared helper must not be picked up as a test suite by the runner.
